meaning: World bone scales are dimensionless relative to authored rest geometry. Pure head/arm vertices have exactly these isotropic linear size ratios. Cross-section area and volume multiples are geometric consequences, not body-mass estimates.
caveat: chestWidth and ratios containing ChestWidth refer to the chest bone transverse scale, not measured thorax width. Arm-girth ratios apply exactly only within regions fully assigned to an arm bone; blended shoulders differ.
